title.zh: 将西内格罗斯省 Cauayan 市镇的 Bulata 描笼涯附属中学从 Linaon 中学分离，名为 Bulata 国立中学并为其拨款
title.en: An Act Providing for the Separation of the Barangay Bulata Extension High School Located in the Municipality of Cauayan, Province of Negros Occidental, From the Linaon High School, to Be Known as the Bulata National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Separation of the Barangay Bulata Extension High School Located in the Municipality of Cauayan, Province of Negros Occidental, From the Linaon High School, to Be Known as the Bulata National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Trường Trung học mở rộng Barangay Bulata tại Thị trấn Cauayan, Tỉnh Negros Occidental khỏi Trường Trung học Linaon với tên gọi Trường Trung học Bulata Quốc gia, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาขยาย Barangay Bulata ในเทศบาล Cauayan จังหวัด Negros Occidental ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Linaon ในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bulata แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang memisahkan Sekolah Menengah Perluasan Barangay Bulata di Kotamadya Cauayan, Provinsi Negros Occidental dari Sekolah Menengah Linaon dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bulata Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta mengasingkan Sekolah Menengah Lanjutan Barangay Bulata di Perbandaran Cauayan, Wilayah Negros Occidental daripada Sekolah Menengah Linaon dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bulata Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

text.en: The Barangay Bulata Extension Class located in the Municipality of Cauayan, Negros Occidental, is hereby separated from the Linaon High School and shall henceforth be known as the Bulata National High School.
The Bulata National High School shall be equipped with four (4) classrooms, one (1) home economics room, and one (1) multipurpose workshop and a provision for one (1) administrative office.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of this Act.

The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Linaon High School-Barangay Bulata Extension. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Bulata National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
